en.title: Modify the String
en.description:
Delete repeated characters until all characters are distinct, and return the lexicographically largest order-preserving result.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.explanation: When a monotonic stack meets a larger character, it pops smaller characters that will still appear later.
